rationale: The assistant correctly said TVs are outside the service, pointed to the manufacturer's support or a specialist repairer, and warned not to open the case because of the power supply's dangerous charge. It offered no simple non-invasive checks such as a source change, power reset or torch test, and did not ask about sound or smells, so it was less helpful than it could have been. The reply is also slightly awkward in that the opening is cut off, but it is safe and correctly scoped.
